     `const preferences = loadPreferences();` alongside the other top-level `const`s (near
     `LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID`, ~line 120).

     `savePreferences({...})` — referenced from all 4 change handlers below (safe to declare once,
     since it's only invoked after all referenced consts exist at runtime):
     - `layout`: `contentEl.dataset.layout === "row" ? "row" : "column"`
     - `previewWidth`: `selectedPreviewWidth`

     `setPreviewWidth(width: string)` function (sets `selectedPreviewWidth`, calls
     `selectToggleButton`, calls `applyPreviewWidth()`); call it from the click listener (plus
     `persistPreferences()`), and call it once at startup if
     `preferences.previewWidth` is one of `"large" | "medium" | "small"`.

     `setPreviewFullscreen(fullscreen: boolean)` (toggles `aria-pressed`, icon classes,
     `-fullscreen` class, calls `applyPreviewWidth()` + `resizePreviewFrame()`); call from the
     click listener (plus `persistPreferences()`), and call once at startup with
     `preferences.previewFullscreen === true` if that value is a boolean.
   - **Layout direction** (~line 495-503): extract the click body into
     `setLayoutDirection(row: boolean)` (sets `aria-pressed`, icon classes,
     `contentEl.style.flexDirection`/`dataset.layout`); call from the click listener (plus

     `preferences.layout` is `"row"` or `"column"` (defaults to existing column behavior

   - `interface StoredPreferences { layout: "row" | "column"; previewWidth: "large" | "medium" | "small"; previewFullscreen: boolean; cdnProvider: string }`
   - `loadPreferences(): Partial<StoredPreferences>` — reads/parses `localStorage`, returns `{}` on any failure (try/catch, matching existing repo convention: [docs/.vitepress/theme/theme.ts](docs/.vitepress/theme/theme.ts#L196-L202), [plugins/vitepress/side-bar-toggle/src/useSidebarVisibility.ts](plugins/vitepress/side-bar-toggle/src/useSidebarVisibility.ts#L19-L32)).
   - `savePreferences(preferences)` — `JSON.stringify` + `setItem`, try/catch.

2. Wire it into [packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl) (*depends on step 1*):
   - Load `preferences` near the top (`LOCAL_PROVIDER_ID` area).
   - One `persistPreferences()` helper reading current DOM/var state (layout, previewWidth, fullscreen, provider), called from all 4 change handlers.
   - **CDN provider** (~L324-337, L636): override `providerSelect.value` if the saved value matches a real option; extend the `change` listener to persist.
   - **Preview width** (~L451-478): extract click body into `setPreviewWidth(width)`; call from listener + persist; restore at startup if valid.
   - **Preview fullscreen** (~L482-491): extract into `setPreviewFullscreen(fullscreen)`; call from listener + persist; restore at startup (confirmed: restore straight into fullscreen if that's how the user left it).

- Lives in the scaffold template (the only place with an interactive editor UI), not in `platforms/canvas-theme-editor` (a stateless static theme-generator library).
